tools.name: run_seo_audit
tools.description: Audit a public homepage and up to two discovered product/collection pages. Requires user authorization. Respects robots.txt; returns findings inline without saving a report or sales lead. Maximum 35 seconds, three attempts per IP per hour, 30 shared audit attempts per hour.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "run_seo_audit" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
